abilities.description: Prevents a target from attacking for 3.5 seconds.

additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
14 main attack damage to universal heroes.
name: Heaven's Halberd
description: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.
tips: Very strong against ranged heroes whose main source of damage are their right-clicks, making them unable to attack for 5 seconds.

Because the disarm displays an icon and can't be dispelled, you can use it to reveal your enemy before it uses a Manta Style or ability to create illusions. It can be very useful against Phantom Lancer.
Ethereal Blade can be an alternative to disarm and amplify the magic damage for a spell caster (however it can be dispelled).
Consider using this item as a counter to Satanic
